## CodeQL / Missing XML validation

This XML processing depends on a [user-provided value](1) without validation because the 'XmlReaderSettings' instance does not specify the 'ValidationType' as 'Schema'.

## Dereferenced variable is always null

Variable missing is always null at this dereference.

## Invalid string formatting

Argument '{1}' has not been supplied to this format string.

## Self-assignment

This assignment assigns value to itself.

## Self-assignment

This assignment assigns _counter to itself.

## Container contents are never accessed

The contents of this container are never accessed.

## Off-by-one comparison against container length

Off-by-one index comparison against length may lead to out-of-bounds access to array element.

## Container contents are never initialized

The contents of this container are never initialized.

## Character passed to StringBuilder constructor

A character value passed to 'new StringBuilder()' is interpreted as the buffer capacity.

## Call to ReferenceEquals(...) on value type expressions

'ReferenceEquals(...)' always returns false on value types - this check is at best redundant and at worst erroneous.

## Potentially dangerous use of non-short-circuit logic

Potentially dangerous use of non-short circuit logic.
